bremenrathaus.name: Bremen Town Hall
bremenrathaus.slogan: Gothic hall, Renaissance show-front, and six centuries of civic pride.
bremenrathaus.line: Built 1405-1410, it was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List with the Roland statue in 2004.

stadtmusikanten.name: Town Musicians of Bremen
stadtmusikanten.slogan: Donkey, dog, cat and rooster: rub the hooves for luck.
stadtmusikanten.line: The Grimms published the tale in 1819, but Gerhard Marcks' bronze only joined the Rathaus wall in 1953.

glockenspielbremen.name: Böttcherstraße
glockenspielbremen.slogan: A brick lane of coffee money, porcelain bells and wild expressionism.
glockenspielbremen.line: Ludwig Roselius, the merchant behind decaffeinated Kaffee HAG, paid for the lane's rebuilding between 1922 and 1931.

auswandererhaus.name: German Emigration Center
auswandererhaus.slogan: Board the ship and walk in an emigrant's shoes.
auswandererhaus.line: Over seven million people sailed overseas from Bremerhaven, and the museum won European Museum of the Year in 2007.

klimahaus.name: Klimahaus Bremerhaven
klimahaus.slogan: Around the world in a day, always along 8 degrees east.
klimahaus.line: Opened in June 2009, its route follows the longitude that runs through Bremerhaven itself.
